title: Natural comparison of lifted tensor-sheaf cohomology with ordinary H
statement: For a quasi-compact separated scheme X, a quasi-coherent module F and q>=0, there is a family m of associated etale endomorphisms with components Gamma(U,u*phi), and an additive equivalence from H^q(X_et,ULift(F_et)) to Scheme.Modules.H(F,q) commuting with all module endomorphisms phi. This compares fixed canonical sheaves, and makes no assertion about an arbitrary sheaf G or scalar presentations.

source.place: Tags 03P2 and 03FD; composition of natural comparisons

proof.text: Take the associated map family and natural etale/Zariski comparison. Apply the natural coefficient-lift comparison to the fixed F and q, and the natural module-cohomology/source-H bridge.

Compose the lift equivalence, the inverse etale/Zariski equivalence and the source-H bridge. The inverse naturality square follows by applying the forward equivalence and cancelling. Rewrite the three squares to prove naturality for all phi. The map components are those from the etale/Zariski theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_source_comparison_natural
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    let E := etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F
    let L := sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}
    ∃ m : (F ⟶ F) → (E ⟶ E),
      (∀ (φ : F ⟶ F) (U : X.Etale),
        (m φ).hom.app (op U) = ((tensorPullback U.hom).map φ).app ⊤) ∧
      ∃ e : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) q ≃+ H F q,
        ∀ (φ : F ⟶ F) (x : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) q),
          e (Sheaf.H.map (L.map (m φ)) q x) = H.map φ q (e x)
